objects.name: The Architect Universe
objects.description: An ambitious 3D WebGL universe crafted for the 3D Websites Hackathon. Featuring 6 living themed worlds, real-time Web Audio procedural soundscapes, NASA astrophysical spectrometry data, custom GLSL shaders, and Nova AI guidance.
scientificFacts: Every world is rendered with custom GLSL procedural fragment and vertex shaders.
Acoustic feedback and drones are synthesized in real-time using the Web Audio API AudioContext.
Interactive 3D raycasting is enabled across all planetary coordinates.
objects.lore: The Architect of Worlds universe was forged to demonstrate that 3D websites can transcend static navigation and create unforgettable emotional interactive journeys.
objects.interestingFacts: Contains 6 handcrafted interactive WOW moments: Anvil Strike, Seed Planting, Ocean Dive, Crystal Spire Refraction, Constellation Stretching, and Time Rewind.
suggestedQuestions: What technologies power this 3D universe?
Who is the Architect of Worlds?
How do I explore all 6 worlds?

objects.name: Terra Earth
objects.description: A lush blue-green terrestrial planet teeming with procedural forests, oceans, cascading waterfalls, and drifting cloud systems. It is the living home of organic life, nature, and humanity in the cosmos.
scientificFacts: Earth is the only astronomical object known to harbor liquid oceans on its surface and support living organisms.
A powerful internal geodynamo generates a protective magnetosphere shielding the surface from solar radiation.
Plate tectonics continuously recycle carbon dioxide and stabilize global temperatures over millions of years.
objects.lore: Terra Earth is the crown jewel of organic life—seeded by the Architect to nurture creative thought, nature, and human discovery.
objects.interestingFacts: Contains over 71% surface water coverage and supports millions of biological species.
suggestedQuestions: What makes Terra Earth unique in the universe?
Compare Terra Earth with Ocean World.
How does the atmosphere support human life?

objects.name: Forge Planet
objects.description: A molten volcanic world of liquid magma, glowing basalt ridges, and intense radiogenic heating. It represents the crucible of trial, engineering, and raw power.
scientificFacts: Volcanic worlds are typically very young or endure extreme tidal heating from nearby gas giants.
Lava rivers indicate a very thin crust and high internal radiogenic heat dissipation.
Heavy element density creates localized gravitational anomalies across lava plains.
objects.lore: The Forge is the Architect's cosmic foundry, where heavy elements and glowing project crystals are forged in the fires of creation.
objects.interestingFacts: Project crystals formed in the mantle contain compressed digital data structures.
suggestedQuestions: What fuels the supervolcano?
Compare Forge Planet with Singularity.
How do project crystals crystallize in magma?

objects.name: Ocean World
objects.description: A vast, deep sapphire ocean planet with bioluminescent deep-sea trenches and leviathan organisms. It represents the endless depths of knowledge.
scientificFacts: Hycean ocean worlds are prime candidates for supporting complex marine life.
High water-column pressure forces deep water to crystallize into exotic Ice VII phases.
Sub-surface bioluminescence generates light through enzymatic luciferin reactions.
objects.lore: A sanctuary of knowledge, where the Architect's memories swim like whales beneath the waves.
objects.interestingFacts: Floating skill bubbles are actual concentrated pockets of technical knowledge.
suggestedQuestions: How deep is the global ocean?
Compare Ocean World with Terra Earth.
What lies inside the deep sea trench?

objects.name: Crystal Moon
objects.description: A jagged icy moon encased in a cracked crystalline crust, shrouded in perpetual snowstorms and vivid multicolored auroras.
scientificFacts: Auroras are caused by the collision of charged solar particles with atmospheric gases.
Tidal flexure from its parent planet heats the subsurface ocean, keeping it liquid.
Crystalline quartz structures refract ambient light into spectral prism beams.
objects.lore: The crystal spires hold the frozen echoes of past civilizations that the Architect attempted to save.
objects.interestingFacts: Snow falls upward during high planetary magnetic alignments.
suggestedQuestions: What causes the multi-colored auroras?
Compare Crystal Moon with Forge Planet.
Is there liquid water beneath the ice crust?

objects.name: Singularity
objects.description: A supermassive gravitational vortex surrounded by a blinding accretion disk of relativistic gas and light.
scientificFacts: The event horizon marks the boundary where escape velocity exceeds the speed of light.
Superheated gas in the accretion disk emits intense X-ray and gamma radiation.
Gravitational time dilation causes time to pass infinitely slower near the horizon.
objects.lore: The gateway to the Architect's personal domain. Only those who master the chaos of code can pass through.
objects.interestingFacts: Time slows down infinitely as you approach the Schwarzschild radius.
suggestedQuestions: What happens when matter crosses the event horizon?
Compare Singularity with Quasar Prime.
How does gravitational time dilation affect space travelers?

objects.name: The Nexus
objects.description: The central golden energy core of the digital cosmos, connecting all worlds, data streams, and orbital realities.
scientificFacts: Central stars contain 99.8% of all matter in planetary systems.
Solar flares emit energetic particles traveling at up to 3 million km/h.
objects.lore: The root directory of the universe where every path begins and every algorithm converges.
objects.interestingFacts: It streams raw energy to all surrounding planets via quantum tether beams.
suggestedQuestions: What powers The Nexus core?
How are surrounding planets tethered to it?
Why is it called the root directory of existence?

objects.name: Pulsar Alpha
objects.description: A rapidly rotating neutron star emitting intense beams of electromagnetic radiation across space.
scientificFacts: Pulsars are super-dense neutron star remnants left behind by massive supernova explosions.
Their rotation speed is so precise they rival atomic clocks.
objects.lore: The Architect uses Pulsar Alpha as a cosmic lighthouse to guide stray matter back into the sector.
objects.interestingFacts: A single teaspoon of pulsar material weighs over 6 billion tons on Earth.
suggestedQuestions: How fast does Pulsar Alpha rotate?
What is degenerate neutronium matter?
How is it used as a cosmic clock?

objects.name: Quasar Prime
objects.description: An extremely luminous active galactic nucleus powered by a supermassive black hole emitting relativistic plasma jets.
composition: Supermassive Black Hole Core & Accretion Ring
scientificFacts: Quasars can outshine entire galaxies containing hundreds of billions of stars.
Relativistic jets shoot out perpendicular to accretion disks at 99.9% light speed.
objects.lore: Quasar Prime powers the entire Architect of Worlds simulation engine.
objects.interestingFacts: Its light has been traveling across space for 12 billion light years.
suggestedQuestions: How bright is Quasar Prime?
What fuels relativistic plasma jets?
How old is this object?
